name: faq-categorized
title: FAQ Categorized
description: FAQ split into categories: a tab list picks the topic, an accordion holds its answers.

props.name: title
props.description: The section headline. Labels the section for assistive tech.

props.name: categories
props.type: { id: string; label: string; items: { id: string; question: ReactNode; answer: ReactNode }[] }[]

props.name: defaultCategory
props.description: Id of the category shown first. Defaults to the first one.

props.name: onCategoryChange
props.description: Called with the category id whenever the tab changes.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
